_about: 내 데이터로 LLM 파인튜닝하기 9장 사양표. 모든 값은 각 항목의 url을 checked 날짜에 직접 읽고 옮겼다. 값이 바뀌면 이 파일을 고치지 말고 날짜가 다른 새 파일을 만든다. claim=true는 회사가 스스로 밝힌 주장이다.

early_stopping.quote_patience: Use with `metric_for_best_model` to stop training when the specified metric worsens for `early_stopping_patience` evaluation calls.
early_stopping.quote_threshold: to denote how much the specified metric must improve to satisfy early stopping conditions.
early_stopping.quote_save_steps: Note that if the [`TrainingArguments`] argument *save_steps* differs from *eval_steps*, the early stopping will not occur until the next save step.
early_stopping.source_rule: check_metric_value: state.best_metric가 None이거나, 새 값이 더 좋고(손실이면 더 작고) abs(새 값 - best_metric) > threshold이면 카운터 0, 아니면 카운터 + 1. 카운터 >= patience이면 학습을 멈춘다.
source_asserts: EarlyStoppingCallback requires metric_for_best_model to be defined
EarlyStoppingCallback requires IntervalStrategy of steps or epoch
early_stopping.source_warning: Using EarlyStoppingCallback without load_best_model_at_end=True. Once training is finished, the best model will not be loaded automatically.

trainer_order.note: _evaluate 안에서 callback_handler.on_evaluate가 먼저 불리고, 그다음 _determine_best_metric이 state.best_metric을 고친다. 그래서 조기 종료는 '이번 값'을 '이전까지의 가장 좋은 값'과 비교한다. _determine_best_metric은 threshold 없이 조금이라도 좋아지면 best_metric을 바꾼다.

training_args.quote_load_best: When `True`, `save_strategy` must match `eval_strategy` (unless `save_strategy` is `"best"`), and if using `"steps"`, `save_steps` must be a multiple of `eval_steps`.
training_args.quote_greater_is_better: `True` if the metric name doesn't end in `"loss"`, `False` otherwise.

generation.quote_do_sample: Whether or not to use sampling ; use greedy decoding otherwise.

peft_disable_adapter.quote: Context manager that disables the adapter module. Use this to run inference on the base model.
peft_disable_adapter.unsloth_interaction: [확인 필요] Unsloth의 FastLanguageModel.for_inference를 켠 모델에서 disable_adapter()가 그대로 기본 모델 답을 내는지는 직접 돌려 확인하지 못했다.

unsloth_inference.note: FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained(model_name = "lora_model", ...)으로 저장한 어댑터 폴더를 불러오고 FastLanguageModel.for_inference(model)를 부른다.

unsloth_hyperparams.quote_loss: If your training loss drops below 0.2, your model is likely **overfitting** — meaning it may perform poorly on unseen tasks.
unsloth_hyperparams.quote_early: **Evaluation early stopping** - enable evaluation and stop when the evaluation loss increases for a few steps.
unsloth_hyperparams.quote_epochs: Recommended: 1-3 epochs. For most instruction-based datasets, training for more than 3 epochs offers diminishing returns and increases the risk of overfitting.

llm_judge_paper.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
llm_judge_paper.quote_biases: We examine the usage and limitations of LLM-as-a-judge, including position, verbosity, and self-enhancement biases, as well as limited reasoning ability, and propose solutions to mitigate some of them.
llm_judge_paper.quote_agreement: strong LLM judges like GPT-4 can match both controlled and crowdsourced human preferences well, achieving over 80% agreement, the same level of agreement between humans.

forgetting_paper.title: LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less
forgetting_paper.quote_underperform: Our results show that, in the standard low-rank settings, LoRA substantially underperforms full finetuning.
forgetting_paper.quote_forget: Nevertheless, LoRA better maintains the base model's performance on tasks outside the target domain.
